Trivy container scan with zero critical vulnerability gate | REQ-002 | Infra | open | ### Acceptance — REQ-001 - Alembic migration creates all tables: `documents`, `document_versions`, `document_metadata`, `validation_tasks`, `validation_decisions`, `audit_log`, `users`, `roles`, `user_roles`, `export_jobs`, `rag_queries` - `documents` table includes: `id` (UUID PK), `external_id` `audit_log` table captures: `entity_type`, `entity_id`, `action`, `actor_id`, `actor_role`, `timestamp`, `old_state`, `new_state`, `metadata_json` - Document lifecycle FSM defined as Python enum with allowed transitions enforced at the domain layer - All entities include `created_at`, `updated_at` audit columns with server-default timestamps - SQLAlchemy models define relationships, indexes on Acceptance — REQ-002 - `ProfileResolver` reads `DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE` env var (values: `aws`, `onprem`) and selects adapter implementations at startup - Abstract adapter interfaces defined for: `ObjectStorageAdapter`, `QueueAdapter`, `EventAdapter`, `SecretsAdapter`, `LogSinkAdapter` - AWS adapter implementations: S3 via boto3, SQS via boto3, SNS via boto3, Secrets Manager via boto3, CloudWatch Logs - On-prem adapter implementations: S3-compatible via boto3 with custom endpoint, approved queue stub, approved event stub, Vault client stub, structured log to stdout/file - Each adapter interface has a contract test suite that runs against both aws and onprem implementations using a test double or localstack - `config/settings.py` uses Pydantic v2 `BaseSettings` with profile-aware field resolution - Feature flags module supports boolean flags with profile-aware defaults - OpenTelemetry tracing and Prometheus metrics instrumentation wired as middleware, profile-independent - Adapter selection is validated at startup; unknown profile raises `ConfigurationError` with clear message - All adapter interfaces are importable from `src/backend/adapters/__init__.py` as stable contracts ### Acceptance — REQ-003 - OIDC middleware validates JWT tokens from configurable IdP discovery URL - Token introspection extracts `sub`, `email`, `roles` (or configurable claim paths) - RBAC decorator/dependency enforces permission checks on FastAPI route handlers - Role-to-permission mapping loaded from database (`roles`, `user_roles` tables from REQ-001) - Predefined roles: `admin`, `operator`, `reviewer`, `viewer`, `ai_user` - Permission matrix: `ingest:write`, `validation:review`, `archive:read`, `archive:search`, `export:initiate`, `rag:query`, `admin:manage` - Unauthenticated requests return 401 with structured error body - Authenticated requests lacking required permission return 403 with structured error body and audit log entry - Auth module exposes `get_current_user` and `require_permission(perm)` as FastAPI dependencies - Integration test validates full OIDC flow with a mock IdP (e.g., using `python-jose` test tokens) - Service-to-service auth supports JWT with `service` role for internal API calls ### Acceptance — REQ-004 - `POST /api/v1/documents/upload` accepts multipart file upload (pdf, docx, xlsx, pptx, jpg, png) with metadata - Upload validates file type, size limit (configurable), and required metadata fields - Uploaded file stored via `ObjectStorageAdapter` with unique key; document record created in `Uploaded` state - Upload publishes `document.uploaded` event via `QueueAdapter` for async processing - OCR worker consumes `document.uploaded`, runs Tesseract + PaddleOCR/docTR, extracts text - Classification worker applies configurable rules to extracted text, assigns document type and metadata - After OCR + classification, document transitions to `Processed` state with audit log entry - Worker failures transition document to an error sub-state with retry metadata; max 3 retries before `ProcessingFailed` - `GET /api/v1/documents/{id}` returns document metadata, current state, and processing history - `GET /api/v1/documents` returns paginated list with filters: state, type, date range, uploader - All endpoints enforce RBAC (`ingest:write` for upload, `archive:read` for listing) - Idempotent upload: re-submitting same `external_id` returns existing document without re-processing ### Acceptance — REQ-005 - `GET /api/v1/validation/tasks` returns paginated list of documents in `Processed` state assigned to current reviewer - Task assignment strategy: round-robin or manual claim (configurable) - `GET /api/v1/validation/tasks/{id}` returns document detail with extracted text, metadata, and OCR confidence scores - `POST /api/v1/validation/tasks/{id}/approve` transitions document to `Validated` state with reviewer notes - `POST /api/v1/validation/tasks/{id}/reject` transitions document to `Rejected` state with mandatory rejection reason - Only users with `validation:review` permission can access validation endpoints - State transition enforced: only `Processed` documents can be approved or rejected - Approval/rejection creates audit log entry with reviewer identity, timestamp, and decision metadata - Rejected documents can be re-submitted for processing (returns to `Uploaded` state) via `POST /api/v1/validation/tasks/{id}/resubmit` - Concurrent review conflict: if two reviewers attempt to decide on the same task, second request returns 409 Conflict - Validation decision is idempotent: re-approving an already-Validated document returns 200 with no state change ### Acceptance — REQ-006 - When a document reaches `Validated` state, an async job archives the file and metadata to long-term object storage - Archived documents indexed in PostgreSQL full-text search (tsvector) on extracted text and metadata fields - `GET /api/v1/archive/search` accepts query string, filters (type, date range, tags), and pagination - Search results include relevance score, document metadata, and state - Search respects RBAC: users see only documents their role permits (`archive:search` permission) - `GET /api/v1/archive/documents/{id}` returns full document detail with download URL (pre-signed, time-limited) - Archive job creates audit log entry for state transition to `Archived` - Full-text search index updated within 30 seconds of archive completion (configurable) - Search supports both exact match on metadata fields and fuzzy match on extracted text - Archive storage uses `ObjectStorageAdapter` with configurable retention prefix ### Acceptance — REQ-007 - `POST /api/v1/export/jobs` creates an export job for selected document IDs with format (pdf, csv, zip) - Export restricted to documents in `Validated` or `Archived` state; request with other states returns 400 - Single-document export returns synchronously if file size < configurable threshold - Batch export (multiple documents or large files) queued via `QueueAdapter`; returns job ID for polling - `GET /api/v1/export/jobs/{id}` returns job status: `pending`, `processing`, `completed`, `failed` - Completed export job provides time-limited download URL via `ObjectStorageAdapter` - Export job creates audit log entry with actor, document IDs, format, and timestamp - Export respects RBAC: only users with `export:initiate` permission can create jobs - CSV export includes configurable column selection from document metadata - Export files are encrypted at rest in object storage per `data_protection` policy - Failed export jobs include error detail and support manual retry via `POST /api/v1/export/jobs/{id}/retry` ### Acceptance — REQ-008 - Embedding worker listens for `document.validated` events and processes only `Validated`-state documents - Worker extracts text chunks from archived document content using configurable chunk size and overlap - Embeddings generated using bge-m3 model via self-hosted inference endpoint (profile-resolved) - Vectors stored in pgvector table with: `document_id`, `chunk_index`, `chunk_text`, `embedding`, `metadata_json` - Embedding job creates audit log entry with document ID, chunk count, and model version - If document metadata is corrected post-validation, `document.metadata_corrected` event triggers re-embedding - Re-embedding deletes old vectors for the document before inserting new ones (atomic transaction) - Worker respects rate limits on inference endpoint; backs off exponentially on 429/503 - Documents not in `Validated` state are rejected by the worker with a logged warning (no state change) - Embedding table includes index on `document_id` for efficient deletion and retrieval - bge-reranker model endpoint configured and health-checked at startup ### Acceptance — REQ-009 - `POST /api/v1/rag/query` accepts `{ "question": "...", "filters": {...}, "top_k": N }` and returns answer with sources - Retrieval queries pgvector using cosine similarity on question embedding, filtered to `Validated`-state document vectors only - Retrieved chunks reranked using bge-reranker before answer generation - Answer generated by self-hosted LLM (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct or Mistral-7B-Instruct, configurable) - Response schema: `{ "answer": "...", "sources": [{"document_id": "...", "chunk_text": "...", "score": 0.95}], "confidence": 0.87 }` - Only users with `rag:query` permission can access the endpoint - Query and response logged to `rag_queries` table (prompt text redacted per `ai_policies.redaction_required`) - If no relevant vectors found above configurable similarity threshold, response returns `"answer": null` with explanation - Endpoint returns 503 if LLM inference service is unavailable, with structured error and retry-after header - Concurrent query limit enforced per user (configurable); excess returns 429 - Integration test validates end-to-end: seed validated document → embed → query → verify sourced answer ### Acceptance — REQ-010 - Next.js 14 app shell with app directory routing and server/client component separation - OIDC login flow: redirect to IdP, handle callback, store tokens in secure httpOnly cookie - Role-aware navigation: menu items visible only for permitted roles (admin sees admin panel, reviewer sees validation inbox) - Dashboard page shows document counts by lifecycle state (Uploaded, Processing, Processed, Validated, Rejected, Archived) as cards or chart - Dashboard data fetched via TanStack Query with 30-second auto-refresh - Zustand store manages client-side UI state (sidebar collapse, active filters, notification queue) - API client module wraps all backend endpoints with typed request/response interfaces - Tailwind CSS + Shadcn/UI component library initialized with consistent theme tokens - Lucide React icons used throughout navigation and status expired token triggers silent refresh or re-login ### Acceptance — REQ-011 - Validation task inbox page at `/validation` lists documents in `Processed` state with sortable columns - Inbox supports filtering by document type, upload date, and assigned reviewer - Clicking a task navigates to `/validation/{id}` detail page - Detail page displays: extracted text (scrollable), OCR confidence requiring rejection reason before `POST /api/v1/validation/tasks/{id}/reject` - Resubmit button available on rejected documents, triggers `POST /api/v1/validation/tasks/{id}/resubmit` - Optimistic UI: approve/reject immediately updates task status in inbox; reconciles on server response - Error handling: 409 Conflict shows "already reviewed" toast; 403 shows "insufficient permissions" toast - Keyboard shortcuts: `A` for approve, `R` for reject (with confirmation), `N` for next task - Task count badge in navigation updates in real-time via polling (30s interval) ### Acceptance — REQ-012 - Archive search page at `/archive` with search input, filter sidebar (type, date range, tags), and paginated results grid - Search results show document title, type, state, relevance score, and upload date - Clicking a result navigates to `/archive/{id}` detail page with metadata and download button - Download button generates pre-signed URL and initiates browser download - Export page at `/export` allows selecting documents from archive results and choosing format (PDF, CSV, ZIP) - Export initiation shows progress indicator; completed exports show download link - Export job history table with status column and retry button for failed jobs - RAG Q&A page at `/rag` with chat-style interface: question input, answer display, source citations - Source citations are clickable links to `/archive/{document_id}` detail page - Confidence score displayed as visual indicator (color-coded bar or badge) - Empty state for RAG: "No validated documents available for Q&A" when vector store is empty - All pages enforce role-based visibility: archive requires `archive:search`, export requires `export:initiate`, RAG requires `rag:query` ### Acceptance — REQ-013 - Admin panel at `/admin` accessible only to users with `admin:manage` permission - User management page: list users, create user (synced from IdP), assign/revoke roles - Role management page: list roles, view permission matrix, create custom roles - Audit log viewer at `/admin/audit` with filters: entity type, actor, action, date range - Audit log table shows: timestamp, actor, action, entity type, entity ID, old state, new state - Audit log entries are read-only; no delete or modify capability - System health dashboard at `/admin/health` shows: API response time (p50/p95/p99), queue depth per queue, error rate (last 1h/24h), worker status - Health data sourced from Prometheus metrics endpoint and backend health check API - `GET /api/v1/admin/health` returns structured health status of all subsystems (db, cache, queue, object storage, LLM) - `GET /api/v1/admin/audit` returns paginated audit log with same filters as frontend - Admin API endpoints return 403 for non-admin users with audit log entry to GPU/LLM integration uncertainty ## Test Strategy ### Per-REQ Mandatory Tests **REQ-001 — Data Contract** - Happy path: `alembic upgrade head` on clean DB creates all tables with correct columns and constraints - Failure path: migration against incompatible schema version fails with clear error - Persistence: insert a document, verify all audit columns populated with server defaults - No-side-effect: downgrade migration cleanly reverses all changes - Dependency contract: SQLAlchemy models importable and usable by downstream test fixtures **REQ-002 — Profile Adapters** - Happy path: `ProfileResolver` with `DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE=aws` returns AWS adapter instances - Happy path: `ProfileResolver` with `DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE=onprem` returns on-prem adapter instances - Failure path: unknown profile value raises `ConfigurationError` - Profile parity: contract test suite passes for both aws and onprem adapters against test doubles - No-side-effect: adapter initialization does not create external resources without explicit call - Dependency contract: all adapter interfaces importable from `adapters/__init__.py` **REQ-003 — Auth/RBAC** - Happy path: valid OIDC token with `reviewer` role accesses validation endpoint - Deny path: expired token returns 401 with structured error - Deny path: valid token without required permission returns 403 with audit log entry - Persistence: 403 with extracted text - Auth deny: upload without `ingest:write` permission returns 403 - Failure path: upload unsupported file type returns 400 with validation error - Failure path: OCR worker failure after 3 retries transitions to ProcessingFailed state - Persistence: document record, audit log entries for each state transition - Idempotency: re-upload with same `external_id` returns existing document (200, not 201) - Dependency contract: `document.uploaded` event published with correct schema **REQ-005 — Validation Workflow** - Happy path: reviewer approves Processed document → Validated state with audit entry - Happy path: reviewer rejects Processed document → Rejected state with reason - Auth deny: non-reviewer user accessing validation endpoint returns 403 - Failure path: approving non-Processed document returns 400 - Concurrency: two simultaneous approvals → first succeeds, second returns 409 - Idempotency: re-approving Validated document returns 200 with no state change - Persistence: validation decision audit log includes reviewer identity and decision metadata **REQ-006 — Archive & Search** - Happy path: Validated document archived → searchable via full-text query within 30s - Auth deny: user without `archive:search` returns 403 - Failure path: search with empty query returns 400 - Persistence: archive creates audit log entry for Archived state transition -
